_about: 101 graphics upgrade (docs/101-ART-PLAN.md). Check with: python3 scripts/game_art.py 101 paint OUT --dry-run

styles.s: Bright flat storybook illustration, clean simple shapes, soft gentle shading, sunny cheerful colours, smooth and tidy like a modern children's picture book or a friendly mobile game, made for children aged 7 to 11. No text, no letters, no numbers, no writing anywhere.

pictures.name: back-bach-day
pictures.prompt: A sunny New Zealand seaside bach deck seen from just behind a wooden outdoor table: weathered wooden deck boards across the bottom, a low wooden railing, golden sand, calm turquoise sea and gentle waves, a green headland on the right, a few round white clouds in a bright blue sky, a pōhutukawa tree with red flowers at the left edge, a striped beach towel over the railing. A quiet, empty place with nobody there, the middle calm and open so things placed on top stand out. Wide landscape.

pictures.name: back-bach-evening
pictures.prompt: The same seaside bach deck at dusk: warm orange and violet sunset over a calm sea, strings of glowing round fairy lights hanging along the top, the wooden deck and railing in soft evening light, a lantern glowing at the right edge, the first stars in the sky. A quiet, empty place with nobody there, the middle calm and open so things placed on top stand out. Wide landscape.

pictures.name: wood
pictures.prompt: Warm honey-brown wooden table planks running left to right, gentle wood grain and a few soft knots, friendly and clean, slightly worn like a beach bach table. Seen flat from straight above in even soft light, a plain seamless texture filling the whole picture.

pictures.name: felt
pictures.prompt: Soft green card-table felt, a calm even mid green with a very faint woven fuzz, plain and smooth. Seen flat from straight above in even soft light, a plain seamless texture filling the whole picture.
